name: alex-sanity-p2-screen
proves: A whole-game sanity screen for one player, co-op: the fake Blue Screen (28) is asked for in player 2's set, their Start puts it up in their half with them held, their presses end it, and player 1 walks through all of it with their own tracker at rest. Its picture comes from /UInsane.tpl (sanity_screen_bank).
source: written 2026-11-18 with player 2's own Blue Screen and Game Reset (hle.c sanity_p2_step's screen block, sanity_overlay)

expect.pattern: the pictures of Game Reset, Blue Screen and To Be Continued read from /UInsane.tpl
player 2 pressed Start with effect 28 waiting: its screen is up in their half
player 2's screen of effect 28 is over after \d+ ticks
